source.title: Semantic Space Search Trajectory Networks
source.authors: Julian Agudelo; A. Tonda; Gabriela Ochoa; Vincent Guigue; Cristina E. Manfredotti; Evelyne Lutton

record.file_problem: Full paper text supplied, including appendices; no truncation or garbling that prevents extraction.
record.tranche_reason: The study conceptually reproduces the natural-label versus shuffled-label comparison using MLP training and test performance, alongside its own trajectory analysis.
record.gate_note: The performance results in Table 5 bear on V1: classification MLPs fit real and shuffled training labels, while their test accuracy differs. The graph metrics and figures describe trajectory structure rather than the claim versions' named outcomes, so they are not additional rows. Results cited from Zhang et al. are not treated as this study's results.
record.test_reason: Table 5 directly repeats the fixed shuffled-label versus natural-label training and held-out accuracy comparison underlying V1, using the same MLP architecture and SGD recipe across label conditions.
record.authors_conclusion: The record's paraphrase is accurate: the authors conclude that semantic-space STNs recover qualitative learning dynamics and distinguish real-label from shuffled-label training through graph structure, supporting a behavioral view of generalization. They leave validation against established generalization measures to future work.
record.recipe_differences: Uses the real-versus-shuffled-label comparison associated with Zhang et al., with MLPs on the paper's benchmark datasets and semantic trajectory analysis; does not reproduce the named architectures and model configurations in V1.
record.method_sensitivity: Dataset and label condition change test performance; the paper also varies label corruption on MNIST, but those graph metrics do not measure a V1 outcome.

fits_no_version.finding: Real-label training produces denser, more efficient, more centralized semantic trajectory graphs; increasing MNIST label corruption progressively reduces the reported graph descriptors.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Semantic trajectory graph structure distinguishes structured-label and randomized-label training in the tested MLPs.

record.problems: The reported test metrics for Bioresponse do not state chance accuracy. The paper uses one MLP configuration and does not test the architectures and ImageNet setting named in V1.
record.rows_left_out: No Table 5 classification train/test results were left out. Regression results in Appendix B, Table 5 were not extracted because the claim versions specify classification accuracy and do not name regression generalization.

untested.parts: Small Inception, AlexNet, ImageNet Inception V3, and the original architecture configurations are not tested. Explicit regularization settings are not fully documented.
No width sweep or test-error comparison beyond interpolation.
No convolutional versus fully connected network comparison.
No adaptive optimizer versus SGD comparison.
No batch-size comparison under fixed epoch budgets.
No magnitude-aware weight-perturbation sharpness measurement or ranking against generalization gaps.
No removal of memorized examples and retraining comparison.

record.verdict_notes: All classification values match Table 5. The paper is not an original source for V1. Missing documentation of a baseline or untested architectures does not itself warrant limits_scope. Graph descriptors do not measure V7's weight-space sharpness.

versions.untested_parts: Tests MLPs on four classification datasets with real and shuffled labels. Does not test the specified small Inception, AlexNet, other MLPs, or ImageNet Inception V3 configurations.
